DIRECTION A — FULL PAGE

Fourteen sections, top to bottom: hero with the live scan · data-source band · "run it on your domain" scanner · the problem · the 90-day sprint · the Evidence Engine · AI visibility (dark) · Growth Credits · pricing · guarantee + founding cohort · FAQ · closing CTA · footer.

Static mockup — nothing is clickable. The scanner input shows its placeholder state; the FAQ shows every answer open so the copy can be read at a glance.

One lever above the artboard changes the accent colour across the whole page.

Mobile covers the first screens only — hero, price, CTAs, the scan card and the source band.

I'll extend it to the full page once the copy is settled, so it only gets built once.

The three directions not chosen, kept for reference.

B · Editorial ledger — serif masthead, scan as a ruled table.
C · Sprint board — all three months above the fold.
D · Price-forward — $97 at 152px, one button.

None of these is being carried forward; delete the page whenever you want it gone.
